description: Engine 5 responded to I-90 westbound mile marker 42 for a fully involved vehicle fire. Single occupant had self-extricated prior to arrival. Vehicle was a 2019 Ford F-150. Fire extinguished using approximately 150 gallons. No injuries. Traffic control established with state police assistance. Vehicle total loss.
notes: Vehicle fire on highway. Occupant self-extricated — rescued count is 0.
